ICS 91.100.30                         CED 05Reaffirmed 20221. ScopeThis standard covers cement concrete flooring tiles of plain cement, plain coloured and terrazo types.NOTE — The provisions of this standard do not apply to chequered tiles.2. Referenced DocumentsThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
